messages.author: bccf789db78f8994
messages.subject: Marker Assignment
parts:
What is the best way to check that marker assignments are correct?

Thanks!
Anna

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Marker Assignment
parts:
I don't have a very comprehensive technique for this at present.

I'd start by using calc_errorlod() and finding markers with very high rates of errors.

Another useful technique would be to treat a SNP as quantitative trait and do QTL mapping with scan1(). That should indicate its appropriate location.

The sorts of investigations I used in my recent G3 paper on genotype diagnostics, where I was looking for badly behaved SNPs, may also reveal markers that are misplaced.
paper: https://doi.org/10.1534/g3.119.400165
related R/qtl2 tutorial: http://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/do_diagnostics.html

karl
